meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'this, it (is)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Если о чём-то постоянно думать, это обязательно произойдёт.
examples.trans: If you think about something constantly, it will definitely happen.

examples.text: Слушай, ты можешь отключить этот противный звук?

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'fiasco' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Vitya, this is a fiasco!

examples.text: На кухне отеля всегда есть фиаско.
examples.trans: In the hotel kitchen there is always fiasco.

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'hold back, restrain myself'.

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё будет хорошо.
examples.trans: Stick with me and everything will be fine.

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё у вас будет хорошо. Потому что я кто?
examples.trans: Stick with me, and everything will be fine for you. Because who am I?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'not', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: Well, do not stay silent.

examples.trans: I am holding back, not congratulating you.

examples.text: Елена, я поздравляю! От всей души я желаю счастья.

meanings.en: to be patient for a little while, to hold on
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'терпеть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to be patient, wait', paired with 'терпеть'.

examples.text: Нам нужно чуть-чуть потерпеть и немножко поработать.
examples.trans: We need to be patient a little and work a bit.
